run_strip_asm_cli: run strip_asm.py with an input assembly file and output path to generate a stripped assembly file
process_asm_strip_directives: process an assembly string to strip unwanted directives, comments, and global declarations
transform_labels_remove_unused: transform assembly labels by normalizing them and removing unused label declarations
process_identifiers_normalize_platform: process identifiers in assembly lines to normalize names across ELF and MachO platforms
find_used_labels_jumps: find all labels referenced by jump instructions in the assembly code
